iteration_2_summary: QA verdict on iteration 1 was 'fail' with OBJ-1 (critical: broken safe-daemon-restart.sh recovery path) and OBJ-2 (major: fork-divergence asymmetry not addressed). Both objections resolved in this iteration. OBJ-1: M14b runtime test-and-degrade added; M8 and M14-P3 route through daemon_restart_hint() which selects between the (currently nonexistent) safe-daemon-restart.sh and the verified-extant systemctl form (happy-daemon{,-jade,-qijie}.service) plus /root/bin/happy-restart.sh shortcut. OBJ-2: M15 success epilogue adds Block 2 (fork-divergence advisory) printing the AHEAD count from git rev-list, naming forward paths (a) force-push and (b) tag-based forward roll, with worked example and copy-string (no auto-execute). M15b adds a code-comment section header. New ACs: AC16 (runtime test-and-degrade) and AC17 (fork-divergence advisory). AC4 revised to allow either recovery branch. Technical Hints precondition rewritten — safe-daemon-restart.sh availability is no longer required.

requirement.clarified: Implement scripts/rollback.sh as the symmetric companion to scripts/deploy.sh. Defer two-virtual-repo end-to-end testing to a follow-up cycle.
requirement.what: scripts/rollback.sh — a hardened bash script that restores /root/happy to a previously-tagged pre-deploy snapshot and forces the three production daemons (default / jade / qijie) onto that older code via global install + bounded polling.
requirement.why: deploy.sh's tail epilogue (line 386) advertises `bash $(dirname "$0")/rollback.sh $PRE_TAG` as the recovery path; the file does not yet exist. Without it, deploy.sh's safety story is incomplete: a deploy that ships and then misbehaves has no scripted rollback procedure.

development_approach.strategy: Author scripts/rollback.sh by mirroring scripts/deploy.sh's structure with rollback-specific gates: (1) reuse helpers + constants verbatim; (2) replace deploy.sh's argument parser with the strict tag-name regex + annotated-tag check + check-ref-format; (3) add M3b git-state gate; (4) tighten M5 untracked-file policy for npm install -g paths; (5) make M6 recovery snapshot mandatory (no skip); (6) add M7 PRE_ROLLBACK capture + TARGET_VERSION read from tag (BEFORE reset); (7) add M8 same-version no-op trap with operator-path message; (8) S2 safety tag with collision-resistant naming; (9) M10 post-reset HEAD verification; (10) replace deploy.sh's single-sleep daemon verification with M12 bounded polling that exits 1 on stale-after-deadline; (11) Phase P0/P1/P2/P3 abort message routing per M14; (12) success epilogue per M15 (no copyable push command); (13) static body audit per M17/AC11.

Live execution by USER ONLY in their TTY against /root/happy (after at least one prior deploy.sh run has produced a stable/...-pre-deploy tag). The dev subagent MUST NOT execute the script.

standards_to_enforce._no_hardcoded_values_rationale: This standard targets app/library code where magic numbers should be named constants. A bash deploy/rollback script's hardcoded paths (/root/happy, /root/.happy*, /var/log/*) and timeouts (90s) ARE the contract — they are operational constants, not magic numbers, and naming them as bash variables (which the spec already does: PROD_ROOT, DAEMON_HOMES, DAEMON_AUTO_UPGRADE_WAIT_SECONDS) IS the enforcement.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex returned 12 substantive findings (all in-scope, none nitpicks): 1) AC8 contradicts M18 — stale daemons must be exit 1, not exit 0; 2) Missing git-state gate (no merge/rebase/cherry-pick/branch=main check); 3) M8 silent-no-op message should include operator path (safe-daemon-restart.sh); 4) Daemon polling should be bounded (10s tick, 90s deadline) not single sleep; 5) AC11 header docs insufficient — add static body audit AC; 6) Recovery-script hook-bypass boundary needs sharper agent-forbidden wording; 7) Optional deploy.sh polish is scope drift — remove entirely (also M19 typo fixed); 8) S2 safety tag collision risk — add existence check + random suffix; 9) Untracked-file policy too permissive — strict reject under packages/happy-cli/** + top-level package files; 10) Tag validation — add git check-ref-format; tag-message verification deferred to Could-have C3; 11) Manual remote-push epilogue dangerous (force-push footgun) — remove copyable command; 12) Abort instructions need phase-awareness (P0/P1/P2/P3).
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 12 findings classified in_scope_real_bug or in_scope_minor; none rejected. Spec was rewritten: M2 strengthened (check-ref-format), M3b added (git-state gate), M5 tightened (path-specific untracked rejection), M8 message extended (operator path), M11 split from M12 (M12 now is bounded polling), M14 made phase-aware (P0/P1/P2/P3), M15 removed copyable push command, M17 added (static body audit), M19 added (exit codes — was M18 in prior draft, fixing the dangling 'M19' forward-reference codex flagged), S2 collision avoidance, AC3b/AC8(rev)/AC9(rev)/AC11(rev)/AC12/AC13/AC14/AC15 added, W7/W8 added (no deploy.sh edits, no _common.sh extraction). Optional deploy.sh polish section deleted entirely.
